BiblicalUsage: Nasaq means to go up or ascend, and its only occurrence is the psalmist's wonder at a God who is everywhere. In Psalm 139:8 David says if I ascend up into heaven, thou art there, and if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that there is no going up high enough to get away from God, and no going down low enough either; the verse is a comfort, not a threat, because the God who is everywhere is the God who knows me.
